prompt.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a THREE-FRAME limited-animation key-pose SPRITE SHEET of this exact young Song dynasty village woman standing on a field road with a deep basket of fresh greens on her arm, turned slightly toward the RIGHT of the image. TWO reference images. The FIRST shows the exact woman to draw: copy identity, face, hair, clothing colours and carried objects from it. Its camera angle is from slightly above and partly from behind; IGNORE that angle. The SECOND reference is a finished three-cell sheet of a different person: copy ONLY its camera angle (eye-level three-quarter view, the same as every other figure on the street), its figure scale and its three-cell layout. Do NOT copy that person. Keep her identity: black hair in a small high bun, ochre-brown jacket with rust trim, rust-red sash, cream apron over a teal-green skirt and rust-red underskirt, the SAME deep round woven basket with a tall loop handle full of leafy greens. Cell 1 (left) = rest: the basket hangs on her bent left forearm by its handle at hip height, her right hand rests on the rim, she smiles calmly. Cell 2 (middle) = picking: she looks down into the basket and her right hand lifts a bunch of greens out of it. Cell 3 (right) = calling out: she raises the bunch of greens toward the right at shoulder height as if calling to a neighbour, smiling, the basket still on her left arm. The feet stay planted on exactly the same spot in all three cells; only the arms, hands, heads and upper bodies move, with believable weight at the hips and knees. Fine ink outlines and muted antique Chinese watercolor exactly matching the first reference, same line weight, same palette, same paper-grain shading. Truly transparent alpha background, no ground shadow, no glow, no grid lines, no numbers, no text. One single horizontal row of 3 equal-width cells, one full group per cell, centered in its cell with generous margin so hands, baskets, scrolls, sleeves and feet never touch a cell edge. Identical character size and identical camera angle in every cell. Redraw at higher detail than the small reference without changing the design. Make every cell match the first reference and match each other as strictly as possible.
